Lady Annalie: I see you have finally decided on something!
You: Yeah.
Lady Annalie: Good choice! You have quite a taste.
You: Thanks I guess.
I’m not sure if getting a compliment on taste from her is a good thing...
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Feel free to come here anytime you want, though the shop is open from 10am to 6pm. 
You: Got it.
Lady Annalie: See you soon! Bye~ Bye~
You: Bye!
